title: Version 0.5.0 - Duraludon and Character Reworks
message: Latest version: 0.5.0 Duraludon joins the roster! This update also adds missing move branches, reworks several characters, and changes Rayquaza's rewards to be more accurate. New Pokemon: Duraludon - Added Duraludon as a playable character. Major gameplay changes Rayquaza: - Securing Rayquaza no longer makes enemy goals defenseless. Living teammates instead receive a shield worth 30% of their maximum HP + 3000. The securing player gains 30 Aeos Energy and teammates gain 15, including teammates waiting to respawn. - While the shield remains, gain 4x base scoring speed, protected scoring, and 40% increased damage against enemy players. Scoring does not consume the shield, and it has no time limit. - The shield is lost on KO or when broken. True damage still interrupts scoring, as does the hit that breaks the shield. Protected scoring does not grant general hindrance immunity. Zapdos keeps its existing goal-weakening effect. Character changes Cinderace - Added Blaze Kick at Lv. 7. - Added cinder (passive) stacks: normal attacks apply one, boosted attacks and direct moves apply two. Reaching five stacks consumes them for bonus damage. Ember, Pyro Ball and Blaze Kick now apply damaging burns and short Attack/Sp. Attack reductions. - Boosted attack damage increased: 130% -> 140% Attack. Ember's direct damage increased. - Low Sweep and Flame Charge now damage enemies along their path. Low Sweep cooldown reduced: 7.5s -> 7s. Flame Charge+ makes the next boosted attack slow by 30% for 2s. - Pyro Ball cooldown reduced: 5s -> 4.5s. Pyro Ball+ reduces Flame Charge or Feint's cooldown by 4s when it damages an opponent, once per cast. - Feint invincibility reduced: 3s -> 0.73s. Cooldown increased: 9s -> 9.5s. Now cleanses slows; its upgrade makes the next three attacks heal for 30% of actual HP damage, but prevents those attacks from critically hitting. - Blazing Bicycle Kick now creates an area explosion with additional damage equal to 14% of enemies' missing HP, rather than only a single-target homing hit. Added its on-hit speed boost and Unite movement-speed, attack-speed and shield buffs. Cresselia - Added Lunar Rhythm (Passive): hitting an enemy player with a regular move, shielding another ally with Lunar Blessing, or actually healing another ally with Moonlight advances the boosted-attack timer by 1s, once per cast. - Boosted attacks now apply sleep on impact rather than when fired. Offensive casts and support-move recovery are shorter, allowing quicker follow-ups. - Added Lv. 11 offensive upgrades: wider Psybeam and a larger Moonblast explosion. Added Lv. 13 support upgrades: a larger Moonlight field or a Lunar Blessing shield worth 17% instead of 15% of Cresselia's maximum HP. - Safeguard and Lunar Blessing now cleanse removable timed debuffs without removing beneficial buffs. Lunar Blessing correctly removes its remaining shield before converting it into healing after 3.5s. - Moonlight now has exactly five healing pulses over 5s. Psybeam healing only counts unique enemy players, not wild Pokemon. - Crescent Crash's maximum flight time reduced: 5s -> 3s. Recasting lands early; damage and sleep now occur at touchdown, with invincibility maintained through descent. Emboar - Replaced Rentless Roast with Inferno Ringbreaker: brace, rush toward an aimed location, and slam the ground. The inner slam launches enemies; the outer edge slows them. Grants a 15%-max-HP shield for 4s and brief Unstoppable. Hitting an enemy player with the slam readies Reckless once. The old extended stat-boost/full-Reckless mode is removed. - Reckless is now consumed only by Heat Crash or Flame Charge, not by support moves. Damage-based charging is limited to once per target every 0.25s; rearm time reduced from 10s to 5s. - Fire Pledge charges are consumed only by connected attacks. Its third connected swing launches all enemies hit for 0.55s instead of 1s. Fire Pledge+ reduces cooldown to 7s. - Heat Crash now deals a landing hit followed by two widening waves, with reduced damage. Reckless launches enemies only on landing instead of repeatedly with every wave. The upgrade improves wave speed and slow strength. - Flame Charge now has a shorter, steerable 1.15s sprint and can be recast to brake early, allowing attacks or another move immediately afterward. Each target can only be hit once per sprint. - Flamethrower now covers point-blank targets and has a faster release. Its upgraded 10%-max-HP shield lasts 3s instead of 4s. Flareon - Basic attack charge now advances only on connected hits. Every third connected attack reduces both move cooldowns by 0.5s once, even against a group, and refreshes Flareon's existing burns to at least 2s remaining. - Burn damage reworked: each second deals 20% Attack + 1% of the target's maximum HP, replacing the old 5%-max-HP ticks every 0.75s. Damage against wild Pokemon and objectives is capped at 200 per tick before defenses. - Attack stacks now require direct damage against burned enemy players; burn ticks and item damage cannot generate stacks. - Takedown launch duration reduced: 1.6s -> 1.2s, or 1.8s -> 1.4s when upgraded. Its slam requires the original target to remain valid and in range. - Flare Blitz's 3s cooldown refund now applies only once per successful cast. Its upgrade correctly extends burns from 2s to 3s. Flygon - Supersonic's incapacitation reduced: 1.2s -> 1s. The slow now lasts 4s total; the upgrade increases its strength from 20% to 25%. Hits follow the traveling soundwave. - Boomburst now correctly reduces both Defense and Sp. Defense instead of applying both reductions to Defense. Its upgrade extends the reductions from 3s to 4s. - Earthquake now allows movement and attacks while its later waves continue. Slows refresh instead of stacking. Earthquake+ grants one 8%-max-HP shield when the final wave hits an enemy player. - Sandstorm+ grants 15% movement speed while Flygon is inside its own storm. - Cyclonic Sand Surge now grants a 15%-max-HP shield and hindrance resistance instead of invincibility throughout the tornado. Each enemy can be lifted only once per cast, and ending the tornado early immediately returns control. Jolteon - Charge no longer consumes part of a full Volt Absorb meter, preserving empowerment for the next offensive move. Replaced its 1s movement lock with a 75% slow for 0.3s. Charge+ adds 10 percentage points to both defensive buffs. - Thunder Fang's empowered sequence is limited to two bites, including during Unite overcharge. Its upgrade extends the on-hit speed boost from 1.5s to 2s. - Discharge grants one follow-up within 3s after a direct hit. The second pass travels 30% less far with a 30% smaller field and higher speed. Its field now also applies the second-pass slow: 20% for 1s, or 35% when upgraded. - Electroweb marks now last 4s, or 5s upgraded. Direct move hits on marked enemies grant a refreshing, non-stacking 30% speed boost for 1s, or 1.5s upgraded. Basic attacks and periodic damage do not trigger it. - Damage-based Volt Absorb gain is capped at 24 points per second. Lightning Blitz retains wall bounces and steering, but spends Unite energy on activation; KO now clears its protected full-meter state. Marshadow - Fighting Spirit stacks now last 4s instead of 3s, refresh together, and can also be gained by landing boosted basic attacks. Multi-stage moves grant only one stack per sequence. - Close Combat is now three manually aimed strikes with 1.25s recast windows, allowing basic attacks and the other move between strikes. Distance per strike reduced: 4.5m -> 3.5m. Its upgrade strengthens the finisher and grants movement speed on hit. - Drain Punch now heals 25% of actual HP damage against players, or 10% against wild Pokemon. Total wild healing is capped at 4% maximum HP; shields and overkill do not grant healing. - Aura Sphere's pursuit must make contact and respects walls. Its other-move cooldown reduction is awarded only on a successful follow-up. The upgrade increases missing-HP damage from 20% to 25%; execute damage against wild Pokemon is capped at 700. - Spectral Thief now steals up to eight removable timed stat buffs, preserving remaining duration up to 6s, or 8s upgraded. Permanent effects and shields cannot be stolen. - Phantom Force now grants only a 0.22s invincible entry dodge, not invincibility for the entire stealth duration. Offensive actions break stealth. Its kick is faster and now stuns enemies against walls for 0.7s, or 1s upgraded. - Mirror Shadow now borrows a supported enemy Unite for one use within 15s. Supported copies: Cinderace, Glaceon, Sylveon, Vaporeon, Emboar, Flareon and Duraludon. Copies use Marshadow's Attack without foreign passives or basic attacks. No eligible enemy means no energy spent; otherwise, channeling spends energy immediately and KO, interruption or expiry does not refund it. Meowstic (Male) - Boosted attacks now slow by 15% for 0.6s; the attack sequence resets after 5s without attacking. Leer now uses a true cone-shaped hit area. - Espurr's debuff protection now blocks eligible effects before they apply and no longer weakens beneficial buffs. Evolved Meowstic now gains 5 flat cooldown-reduction points per nearby living, non-invisible enemy player, capped at 25. - Reflect now reduces and stores physical damage only, rather than reducing all damage types. Shield absorption contributes to storage. Recast to detonate early; recipient KO also detonates it. The upgrade raises the cap from 2500 to 3000. - Magic Coat now prevents eligible debuffs and hindrances before they interrupt allies, then reflects them to the nearest visible enemy player instead of a random enemy. Reflections cannot bounce between coats. Its upgrade extends duration from 4s to 5s. - Psychic no longer grants an unintended 35% generic damage reduction. It correctly grants 15% Defense and Sp. Defense, with independent offensive debuffs capped at 60%. Its upgrade increases healing. - Wonder Room upgrade now increases allied Defense and Sp. Defense bonuses from 15% to 20%. - Mystic Harmony now allows attacks, regular moves and battle items after its short startup instead of locking them for the full field duration. Scoring remains disabled. Each ally receives its shield only once per cast, and that shield expires when the field ends; leaving and re-entering cannot refill it. Sylveon - Added Mystical Fire at Lv. 4. - Added Draining Kiss at Lv. 6. - Implemented Pixilate: dealing or taking damage grants refreshing 5% Sp. Attack stacks, up to four for 1.5s. Evolved Sylveon also gains Sp. Defense. - Baby-Doll Eyes is now a sure-hit projectile. - Calm Mind cooldown reduced: 10s -> 8s. Movement-speed bonus reduced: 40% -> 30%. Calm Mind+ blocks the next move-damage instance and grants a shield, but does not block basic attacks or hindrances. - Fairy Frolic now heals for 60% of landing HP damage, followed by 50% of actual HP damage for 10s. Shield damage and overkill no longer inflate healing. Vaporeon - Added Hydration (Passive): protecting or actually healing another ally grants 10% personal movement speed for 1.5s, once every 6s after evolving. - Added Whirlpool as the Lv. 6 alternative to Dive: a 3s field with six damage pulses, a 25% slow and one inward pull. The upgrade increases the slow to 35%; overlapping Whirlpools cannot chain pulls immediately. - Aqua Ring's Attack/Sp. Attack bonuses reduced: 45% -> 25%. Breaking its shield now ends the buffs and remaining healing. Aqua Ring+ increases its shield from 20% to 25% of the recipient's maximum HP. - Rain Dance now uses a short hop. Its upgrade increases allied Defense/Sp. Defense bonuses from 55% to 65%. Overlapping field slows no longer stack. - Dive now lasts up to 3s, allows wall traversal with a safe emergence position, and gives enemies a 0.25s resurfacing warning. Its cooldown begins on emergence; Dive+ reduces it from 10s to 9s. - Turbo Tempest's Defense/Sp. Defense reduction decreased: 50% -> 35%. Fixed invalid enemy targets being treated as healing recipients. Controls and battle readability - Added short follow-up input buffering to reworked characters, making it easier to chain moves during recovery. - Stored-use moves now display their reserve count and recharge separately from the delay between casts. - Mobile: drag to pan the battle camera, and tap a landing location to use the super jump pad. - Burns now damage players, wild Pokemon and objectives with correct damage/KO credit. Different casters' burns can coexist, and cleansing a burn stops its damage. On certain platforms the player clothes may take more time to load. Thank you for downloading this game, welcome to the my unite recreation! As this is an early build bugs are expected and 100% going to happen, if you find any please report them in my discord server (link in the itch page) Currently not every feature from the original is implemented, here's a list of features that are missing and planned to be added: - More settings options - Other things i may have missed But why should you play this? Idk at least you can't get slowbro united here. Jokes aside this is mainly so my concepts can actually be played. If quick join isn't finding any match it's likely that there are no open rooms at the moment, in that case i suggest you create an open room yourself. Lastly i hope you enjoy the experience and have some fun! Made with passion by JustMarcy (Of course the original game is owned by Timi studios, this project was purely made for educational purposes and does not intend to replace in any way the original)
